caseNameFull: Newsom v. Smyth, Superintendent, Virginia State Penitentiary
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. A. S. Harrison, Jr., Attorney General of Virginia, and Thomas M. Miller, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Appeals of Virginia granted. Case transferred to appellate docket.
